_rationale: WA has no ordinary state tax. WA 7% LTCG kicks in only above the standard deduction (RCW 82.87.060) — $270k 2024 indexed value, one combined deduction per couple, indexed forward from 2024; in this 2026 scenario with 0% inflation it stays at $270k. (Earlier data wrongly anchored $262k, the 2023 value.) Federal LTCG 15% applies to full gross. Withdrawal w solves: 0.85w − 0.07(w − 270000) = 400000 → 0.78w = 400000 − 18900 = 381100 → w ≈ $488,590. State LTCG ≈ 0.07·($488,590 − $270k) = $15,301. Federal LTCG ≈ $73,288.
